title: Tailwind Cycles
summary: Run a bike repair shop: take call-outs around the valley, build each bike on a 3D stand from real parts, then prove it on a physics-driven test ride.

title: Wold
summary: Open-world farming sandbox on real LIDAR terrain of a Cotswold valley: drive the tractor, work the fields and run the farm's books.

title: Cozy Coaster
summary: Cosy theme-park builder: lay coaster track piece by piece, add scenery and watch guests ride.

title: Groundskeeper: field test
summary: Drive a robot mower over shader-driven grass, ruts and mud, with a scan view, trimmer, jobs and photo mode.
deviceNeeds: Desktop GPU recommended; keyboard or touch.

title: Grid Down Acres: Homestead
summary: Ten-day off-grid homestead sim: build solar, tanks and plots, juggle weather, power and water, and keep the HOA off your back.

title: Grid Down Acres: Day One
summary: First-person farm chores: patch the barn, mount solar panels, plant the veg plot and pen the sheep before sunset.
deviceNeeds: WebGL-capable browser; keyboard and mouse or touch.

title: Coaster builder
summary: Snap together roller-coaster track from a full piece library, check clearances, then ride it.

title: Track parts
summary: 3D catalogue of every coaster track piece with entry and exit markers, clearance boxes and a preview train.

title: Building kit
summary: 3D catalogue of park scenery pieces (walls, roofs, towers and props) built from procedural models.

title: Meadow Mow: Park Keeper
summary: Procedurally generated park to mow with helper drones: draw patrol paths, fence off lawns and ride along in a fisheye drone cam.

title: Little Line
summary: Cosy isometric railway builder: connect stations, run trains, research new eras and grow villages across islands.
deviceNeeds: Any current desktop or mobile browser.

title: Mini Dash Cup
summary: Build and tune a mini 4WD racer, then cheer it through a three-round cup. Includes a course designer.
deviceNeeds: Any current desktop or mobile browser.

title: Roller Riot
summary: Mini 4WD combat racing on an orange tabletop track: tune parts in the pit, then bash rivals off the walls and jump.

title: Slotless
summary: Open-track mini 4WD battle racer with side-slams, a ramp jump, wave section and an unwalled elevated stretch.

title: Timebox
summary: Hour-by-hour day planner: brain-dump tasks, fill the boxes, drag to reshuffle and tick things off. Saves in your browser.
deviceNeeds: Any current desktop or mobile browser.

title: Acrylic kit: 3D builder
summary: Bolt laser-cut acrylic parts together hole by hole in 3D; the cut list and screw count update as you build.
deviceNeeds: Desktop browser with a mouse recommended.
